description.text: The tenth expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 18 April 2025, built around Team Rocket's Pokémon. Every Pokémon whose name begins with Team Rocket's counts as a Team Rocket's Pokémon, whichever member of Team Rocket is drawn on it, so they can be played together. Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex, Team Rocket's Crobat ex, Team Rocket's Moltres ex, Team Rocket's Nidoking ex and Team Rocket's Persian ex lead it, and Giovanni and other members of Team Rocket, among them Ariana, Archer, Petrel and Proton, came as Trainer cards. Arboliva ex, Cetitan ex and Regirock ex join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 98, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex, Team Rocket's Crobat ex and Jamming Tower. In English most of its cards came out in Destined Rivals in May 2025.
